== Summary ==
Slip “AT-M6 Cannon” cut unchanged from page 6 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 75, 1102, 798)). Version [[AT-M6 Cannon]] (Original). Not a recreation.
